title: Smooth action but minimal installation instructions, and very difficult to install
text: Smooth action but minimal installation instructions, and very difficult to install. Ball bearing slides seem well built, but the basket wire only runs left to right, i.e., there are no wires running front to back, which would add needed strength to the shelf.  The mounting holes of the feet are under the wire shelf, not to the side.  The meager assembly instructions tell you to assemble the shelf on the feet before installation, then set it in place to mark the holes to determine where the holes for mounting need to be drilled in your cabinet.  But then you can't get the front feet screws installed because they are very small and have to be held in position through the wire of the shelf before screwing in, which is nearly impossible. You need to disassemble the basket off the slides to finish screwing the front feet in, then line up the basket to the slide clips and reattach the basket to the slides, which is not as easy to do as when the slides are unmounted.  The very small phillips head screws are cheaply made, strip easily, and one wasn't even fully cut so couldn't be used.  Spend the extra money and get sliding shelves better designed for ease of installation.
